newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower, seen steadying.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower, seen steadying.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate closed lower on Tuesday as major banks continued to liquidate excess funds, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 4.951 percent against Monday's 5.137 close, with 30-day commercial paper stable at 5.20-25 against 5.25. Dealers said they expected liquidity to tighten amid routine monthly payroll demand.
The bond market saw no transaction in the afternoon. The seven-year 83/2 bond yield ended morning trading at 5.495-5000 and the 10-year 84/1 bond yield finished at 5.705-710.
